# Nexa

## Founder
Name: Ibrahim
Age: 18 years 2 months
Location: Port Sudan, Sudan
Background: Self-taught developer since age 12, left school due to financial conditions, living away from family for 5 years.
Mission: Build financial freedom for Sudanese merchants.

## Project
Name: Nexa
Type: Sudanese Financial OS - E-commerce + Digital Wallet + Escrow
Tagline: Protecting merchants capital via USDT against inflation.

## Core Tech
- Backend: Python FastAPI
- Frontend: Flutter + Flet
- Database: PostgreSQL with Decimal(28,8) and SELECT FOR UPDATE locking
- Blockchain: USDT TRC20, BEP20, Polygon
- Security: WAF, Rate Limiting, Device Fingerprint, Ethical Disclosure
- Key Tables: marketplace_held_funds, wallets, marketplace_orders
- Features: USDT Wallet, Escrow (held/released/refunded), Virtual Visa via US LLC (Wyoming), AI Sales Agent

## Ethical Security Reports
- Genihat.com: Found open FTP (21) and MySQL (3306)
- Bot "Katem": Found fake API using random()
- zid-cash.com: Found User Enumeration and exposed /admin/login

- GitHub: https://github.com/getnovix/Nexa.docs
